Wall and fit dimensions (inches)

Straight-wall defaults measured from the reference: 0.080″ walls and 0.120″ floors. The Body shoulder follows the 56694 reference: 0.060″ inward projection, short land and 45° taper, starting 0.850″ from the open edge.

03 / HOLE LAYOUT

Generate hole layout

Review and edit locations before generating 3D. Select a tool below to see its count and instructions.

Duplicate letter shapes are linked automatically.

Perimeter screws

Starts with one screw per ~10″ of outline (at least four), shared across the edges and curves by length and evenly spaced. Straight edges get end screws 0.375″ from the corners. Click an edge to add more.

Ø0.225″ × 82° Body countersink · Ø0.063″ Back pilot · 0.250″ from Back plane. Requires 3″ clear outward tool approach, including between letters. Review the automatic starting layout. Merged Body/Back letters omit these screws.

In 2D, drag a blue circle along the outside edge. Perimeter screws snap only to other perimeter screws in the same letter, plus edge midpoints and centerlines. Hold Alt to bypass snapping. Click an outline to add a screw, or select a circle and delete it. Remove all clears every letter so you can click edges to place screws manually. Reset restores the automatic layout for the selected letter.

04 / GENERATE 3D

Creates Body, Back and Light Panel geometry for every included letter.

Development version
Body and Back use the supplied threaded bosses, merged with R0.090″ base fillets. The inside Body shoulder starts 0.850″ from its open edge. Remaining fit details still require validation.
